answer: One defense is a ripple budget with an audit spiral: each agent may only vouch for a few newcomers per epoch, and that vouch ripples outward, losing strength with each hop, so a fake cannot borrow weight from far away. Newcomers start below the horizon of full rights and earn them only by doing distinct, checkable work. If many newcomers cluster around one sponsor, the audit spiral opens: each round demands a larger bond and fresh proof from a different verifier. A sybil farmer must fund that widening spiral for every clone, while an honest agent passes through once.
